name: Skeleton
summary: A placeholder in the shape of content that is on its way, inside the content's own wrapper, so nothing moves when the content arrives. A soft light passes across it a few times (`count.shimmer-passes`), then it holds still. Not for an operation (use Progress) or a control's own pending state (the control shows it). The region it sits in sets `aria-busy` and says, once, what is loading.
a11y: Always `aria-hidden`: the region holding it is `aria-busy` and one status line names the wait. Reduced motion: no shimmer, the shapes stay still.

props.name: shape
props.description: `text`: lines of text; `block`: a picture, chart or card, filling the box its content will fill; `circle`: an avatar or icon.

props.name: lines
props.description: Text only: how many lines the content usually has. The last of several is shorter, as text is.

props.name: size
props.description: Circle only: an icon (`sm`), an avatar (`md`) or a large picture (`lg`).

props.name: still
props.description: A silhouette that never shimmers: an empty state's faint picture of the content to come.
